episode_summary: In this episode, Ben Lalez discusses the ongoing Compass vs. Zillow MLS dispute and its implications for real estate agents. He shares innovative AI-driven solutions like 'offer shield' to reduce deal cancellations and improve market positioning. The episode emphasizes the importance of agent advocacy and leveraging technology to stay competitive in the evolving real estate landscape.
